description: Ba₃Na₂(CN₂)₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six N atoms to form face-sharing NaN₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.74 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six N atoms to form face-sharing NaN₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.72 Å. There are three inequivalent Ba sites. In the first Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one C and six N atoms. The Ba-C bond length is 3.01 Å. There are a spread of Ba-N bond distances ranging from 2.72-3.06 Å. In the second Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 13-coordinate geometry to five C and eight N atoms. There are a spread of Ba-C bond distances ranging from 3.05-3.35 Å. There are a spread of Ba-N bond distances ranging from 2.86-3.41 Å. In the third Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to one C and seven N atoms. The Ba-C bond length is 3.00 Å. There are a spread of Ba-N bond distances ranging from 2.71-3.06 Å. There are five inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to three Ba and two N atoms. Both C-N bond lengths are 1.24 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Ba and two equivalent N atoms. Both C-N bond lengths are 1.24 Å. In the third C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Ba and two N atoms. There is one shorter (1.24 Å) and one longer (1.25 Å) C-N bond length. In the fourth C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Ba and two N atoms. Both C-N bond lengths are 1.24 Å. In the fifth C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Ba and two equivalent N atoms. Both C-N bond lengths are 1.24 Å. There are eight inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, two Ba, and one C atom. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, three Ba, and one C atom. In the third N site, N is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Ba and one C atom. In the fourth N site, N is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Ba and one C atom. In the fifth N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, three Ba, and one C atom. In the sixth N site, N is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, two Ba, and one C atom. In the seventh N site, N is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, two Ba, and one C atom. In the eighth N site, N is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, three Ba, and one C atom.
